prompts.label: banner
prompts.text: Wide horizontal composition depicting a dynamic scene of floating lifestyle elements representing different dad archetypes: a sleek tech gadget glowing softly, a rugged multi-tool with outdoor gear, a chef's knife with subtle kitchen elements, and a cozy coffee setup, all arranged in an asymmetrical diagonal flow across the frame. Each element is stylized as a 3D cartoon object with subtle motion lines, connected by flowing abstract shapes and geometric patterns that create visual rhythm. The background features a soft gradient that transitions from warm teal to coral, with floating sparkles and decorative swirls that add movement without clutter. Modern flat illustration with soft 3D-style characters and objects, combined with subtle 2D decorative elements. Use warm, vibrant pastels (teal #00A99D, coral-orange #FF6B35, sunshine yellow #FFD700). Layout must be clean and giftable, using rounded forms, balanced negative space, and minimal visual clutter. The tone should feel cheerful, light, editorial, and creative — never realistic or photorealistic.

prompts.label: og
prompts.text: Isometric perspective composition looking down at a raised rectangular platform in light teal with a white base. On the platform, arrange a collection of dad-focused gift items in a balanced, asymmetrical layout: a sleek tech gadget (smart watch or wireless charger), a coffee maker or French press, a multi-tool or outdoor gear item, a book or leather wallet, and a cooking utensil or grill accessory. Each object rendered in soft 3D cartoon style with clay-like texture, subtle shadows, and clean lines. The background features a smooth gradient transitioning from rich teal-blue at the top to lighter teal-blue at the bottom. Add stylized four-point orange-yellow stars scattered around the platform and thin curved orange accent lines connecting some objects. The platform appears elevated and floating, with objects having depth and volume. Use a cohesive color palette of teals, deep blues, bright coral-orange, and clean whites. Modern flat illustration with soft 3D-style characters and objects, combined with subtle 2D decorative elements. Use warm, vibrant pastels (teal #00A99D, coral-orange #FF6B35, sunshine yellow #FFD700). Layout must be clean and giftable, using rounded forms, balanced negative space, and minimal visual clutter. The tone should feel cheerful, light, editorial, and creative — never realistic or photorealistic.
